baseline: 370 existing reviewed train glyphs; separate historical/cohort control, not the first prefix of external data. Re-evaluate comparable checkpoints on the unchanged new benchmark only after its approval.
sampling: Prefixes of indivisible connected source-group, image, SHA256 and duplicate-component units. Report actual sample count, group count, class distribution and overshoot. Do not mix protected data or automatically create independent source groups.
independence: Document source-domain and capture provenance, exact SHA256, near-duplicate and plate-crop conflicts. If vehicle identity is unknown, do not call the benchmark vehicle-independent. This supplemental protocol does not waive the frozen benchmark gates or Pilot/New10/Final Test protocols.
comparison: Use identical development IDs, crop, reading order, classifier settings and preprocessing across sizes within a track. No tuning on final test. Only evaluate exact and CER on a separate fixed verified plate-text cohort; no metric from partial glyph labels.
review: Two queues; class-balanced glyph sample and image-level completeness sample. Risk/domain panels overlap and are deliberately enriched, not representative of corpus prevalence. Report denominators by stratum, inconclusive separately, and no population-wide error rate from the pooled sample.
